name: traderevolution-bo
description: Ask in plain words what a TraderEvolution Back-Office report shows, what its columns mean, and which one to use — answered from a local catalogue of every report and its columns, without calling the API. Runs the report when you want the data, and reaches the rest of the BO Swagger specification when a question needs more. Read-only until writes are explicitly enabled.

bo_base_url.title: BO API base URL
bo_base_url.description: Base URL including the basePath, without a trailing slash. Example: https://un-demo.traderevolution.com:8443/proftrading/rest

bo_login.title: BO login
bo_login.description: Your own back-office login. Each user authenticates as themselves, so back-office permissions and audit records stay per-person.

bo_password.title: BO password
bo_password.description: Your own back-office password. Stored in your local Claude Code settings, never in the repository.

bo_allow_writes.title: Allow write requests
bo_allow_writes.description: Off means GET only. On permits POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE, except the endpoints protected below.

bo_allow_dangerous.title: Allow money and user-destructive endpoints
bo_allow_dangerous.description: Permits account operations (deposit, withdrawal, adjustment), user and account deletion, password resets and position rollbacks. Enable only against a demo or test server.

bo_insecure_tls.title: Skip TLS verification
bo_insecure_tls.description: Enable only when the BO server presents a self-signed certificate, typically on demo and test environments.
